title: LLM isolation X7: ship, role and docdelete hold for every family through the sandbox, the fence and the gates; guard phase also blocks Task
summary: The four kernel guards exist only as Claude Code hooks (.claude/settings.json), so agy, codex and ollama panes get none. guards/phase.go:22 checks only the tool name Agent, so Task passes although the hook matcher is Agent|Task. Spec: docs/architecture/llm-isolation.md §9, §14.2 and §23.
fix: Pin each hook guarantee in a CLI-neutral layer: the sandbox write rules and treefence for role, the ship gates for ship, the fence for docdelete. Fix guards/phase.go to deny Task. Add contract rows for an agy pane writing a protected path and for kill(-1). Mark the hooks as defence in depth in docs and tests.
acceptance: RED first: row N10 (an agy pane writes a protected path with exit 0) fails before and passes after
Row N11: guard phase denies a Task call during a cycle
A contract row shows kill(-1) from a cell reaches no host process
CLAUDE.md and skills/loop/SKILL.md describe the hooks as defence in depth
Changed functions at 100% coverage; spec and the guards package note updated
